name: use-swipe-navigation
title: useSwipeNavigation
description: Swipe between tabs with an axis-locked touch gesture that flips direction under RTL.
docs: Any TabBar should be paired with this so tabbed content swipes. Attach the handlers to a touch-pan-y wrapper only when count >= 2. The wrapper must be viewport-sized (min-h-[calc(100dvh-6rem)] md:min-h-0), since a content-height wrapper silently ignores swipes below short content.
